ns0:g.ns0:text: Turned pocket edge; zigzag stays in allowance
Use the qualified stretch zigzag along the turned attachment perimeter.
Free insertion edges remain open. Set width and length on coupons; do
not substitute a rigid straight stitch.

ns0:g.ns0:text: Tunneling: review thread tension, needle spacing and fabric support. Skipped stitches: confirm needle system, point, condition and threading. Cracking under stretch: review
seam formation and thread consumption. Do not assume a domestic serger flatlock is an industrial flatseam. Sources: COATS, SCHMETZ, PEGASUS.
